editorial:
Imagine getting stuck in a fancy house with people you thought were your best friends, only to find out they all secretly hate each other. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a group of old college buddies who gather for a big birthday party at a luxury lodge. At first, everything looks perfect with expensive wine and fake smiles. But once a massive storm hits and cuts them off from the world, the polite act disappears. It quickly turns into a wild ride where every hidden secret and old grudge comes flying out. The vibe is a mix of a party gone wrong and a messy family fight, making you feel like you are right there in the room with them.

The acting is top-notch because the actors make the fighting feel real and awkward. You will love how the tension builds up until someone finally snaps. While a few parts of the story drag a bit in the middle, the big twists keep you glued to your seat. If you enjoy movies where people just scream at each other until the truth comes out, you need to see this.
endingExplained: Everything blows up when it is revealed that the birthday boy actually stole a business idea from one of his friends years ago. After a huge shouting match and some broken furniture, the storm finally clears. Instead of making up, the group decides they are better off as strangers. They leave the lodge in total silence, realizing their friendship was based on lies. It ends with a funny shot of the house in ruins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves messy group dynamics and dark comedies.
